skills.description: Draft, schedule and publish social media posts through a Peal server, with the peal command line or its HTTP API, and read how they went. Use when a task writes, schedules, publishes, moves, cancels or checks posts in Peal, uploads media to it, reads its analytics, ad accounts or activity log, boosts a published post as an ad, or sets up a script or an agent that does. Covers signing in or using a workspace API key, finding channel and media ids, idempotent sending, reading outcomes, errors and rate limits.
skills.name: peal
